title.narrative: EU System for an Enabling Environment for Civil Society (EU SEE): Coordination, Monitor and Early Warning Mechanism

description.narrative: The global objective: Civil society partners at global, regional and partner country levels, capacity and ability to detect and respond to situations of a deteriorating or improving enabling environment, and address and contribute to structural prerequisites for such an environment to be improved. TI’s main roles are supporting the monitoring with country-level data focusing on anti-corruption activists, capacity building on civil society participation in decision-making and whistleblowing, and sub-granting to national chapters. Total value of the contract is EUR 30,000,000, TI-S's budget is EUR 1, 500,000~. The project is funded by the Directorate General for International Partnerships (DG INTPA), European Commission and led by HIVOS.

recipient-region.narrative: This project is managed by TI-S which is headquartered in Germany and is a global poject.
